C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS.Summary: Make three toolkit checks able to observe the thing they are named for: ship the nine packed production modules CI never sees (A48.5), feed the scope audit a real diff and refuse the empty-porcelain false clean (corr 138 / A51.1), and resolve archived plans with an explicit absence when the audit is skipped (corr 139 / A51.2).
C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS.Problem:
Three surfaces share one shape — a green result produced by a check that was never in a position to be red (D16; A51.4; A46.4):
1. A48.5 / ship path. Re-derived at e8a5c5c: `bun run validate:packed` fails with `Cannot find module './gates/command' from '…/node_modules/@neograce/cli/src/grace.ts'`. The gap is the nine-file transitive import closure from `src/grace.ts` (52 production modules) that `package.json#files` does not cover:
src/gates/catalog.ts, command.ts, core.ts, ledger.ts src/review/catalog.ts, command.ts, core.ts, scope-helpers.ts, shape-data.ts
`src/calibration` is already on `files` (Phase 9 / #31). `validate:packed` is **not** in `validate:ci` (`package.json` scripts); it is in `validate:release` / `prepublishOnly`. Published `@neograce/cli@6.0.1` predates both directories and is fine; six merged PRs (#26–#31) reported green CI while the ship path was red. `npm pack` currently yields 47 files with zero from gates/ or review/.
Trap: adding whole `src/gates` and `src/review` also ships `src/review/scorer.ts`, which imports `../test-support/defect-corpus`. `src/test-support` is deliberately not in `files`. `scorer.ts` is imported by no production module (only `scorer.test.ts`); `src/lint/catalog.ts` duplicates defect-pattern ids for the same reason (invariant 7). `validate:packed` would not catch a shipped scorer because it is not reachable from the entry point — the smoke fails on the first missing module only.
2. Correction 138 / scope audit input. `listRepositoryChangedFiles` (`grace-cursor.ts:1135`) runs `git status --porcelain=v1 -z`. At close time porcelain is empty → `{ available: true, changedFiles: [] }`. Because `Boolean([])` is true, the guard at `review/core.ts:886` (`changedFiles && scopeFiles.length > 0`) **enters** the audit with an empty set when a plan is resolved under active/, and reports zero findings — a false clean, not a skip. `ngrace review` exposes only `--path`, `--change`, `--format`; `ReviewOptions.changedFiles` has no CLI binding. A51.1's close-time witness: C-SELECTION OWS missed `scripts/release-check.ts` and `src/artifact/scale-ergonomics.test.ts` (and the draft `C-OBSERVABLE-CHECKS/spec.xml`); re-derived close-time count against PR #29 files remapped archive→active is **3** `review.scope-outside-write-scope` findings that never printed.
3. Correction 139 / archived subject. `runReview` resolves plan only under `changesActiveDir` (`review/core.ts:874`). For any archived bundle `scopeFiles` stays empty, the guard is false, the audit never runs, and the summary still prints `No review findings`. Re-derived: **12** archived bundles (all with plan.xml and OWS), 0 active-path resolve hits. The silent-skip path is the common case.
Phase 8's board row stays COMPLETE. None of these is a defect in Phase 8's selection surface; they are Phase 5/6 surfaces that later closes cited as evidence. This bundle is standalone — not a phase of RM-AGENT-RELIABILITY — and continues correction numbering from findings 169's parents (A48.5, A51.1, A51.2).

Goals.Goal: package.json#files covers every production module in the grace.ts import closure. Preferred shape: directory entries `src/gates` and `src/review` plus exclusion `!src/review/scorer.ts` (same pattern as `!src/artifact/test-fixtures.ts`), with dual-allowlist (`scripts/release-check.ts` PACK_ALLOWED_PREFIXES) kept honest. validate:packed green at HEAD.
validate:ci includes validate:packed. Cost re-derived at ~1.75s wall when green — cheap enough to join the existing script chain directly, not only prepublishOnly.

ngrace review accepts a caller-supplied diff: `--base <ref>` (CLI computes the changed path set) and/or `--changed-files` (explicit paths). Post-commit close can feed the scope audit. Help text names the flags.

When `--change` is set and no changed-files source is available (clean porcelain and neither flag supplied, or git unavailable), the scope audit emits absence with a reason — never a silent clean and never an empty-array pass. "No review findings" is false when the audit did not run.
runReview resolves plan.xml under changesActiveDir or changesArchiveDir. An archived `--change` still supplies ObservedWriteScope when a diff input is also present.
When `--change` names an id with no plan under active/ or archive/, the scope audit emits absence with a reason, never a silent clean scope result.

Constraints.Constraint: Spec only until planned and approved. Stage 1 re-derives and revises this draft; it does not authorize production code. Stage 2 plans; gate approve; then implement.
Do not reopen Phase 8 or edit archived C-SELECTION. The OWS omission is recorded in A50's append-only correction (A51); the archive stays immutable.
F1 / invariant 8: ngrace review remains read-only. Diff input is evaluation input, not a write path. Recording verdicts stays on ngrace gate verdict.
D14: review.* codes stay on the review surface; lint never emits them. No new gate.* from lint. Absence for skipped audits is review output (text + JSON), not a lint code.
Absence with a reason (D5, rule 7) for every skipped audit path. A skipped audit that prints like a passed audit is the failure this change exists to prevent (A43.1 / A51.2).
Do not weaken validate:packed to make it pass. The smoke test is the only surface that has been telling the truth about the ship path.

Standing rule 12: every behaviour this change adds is measured against this repository before it ships. Close-time scope audit on C-SELECTION with a real diff yields 3 errors (severity stays error — fixable, not legacy-unfixable). Absence paths are counted too.
Standing rule 11: every emitted "No review findings" / absence string must read true aloud given the inputs the run actually had. Four required sentences: clean run, dirty run, no diff, no plan.
Standing rule 13: write into the record what a later reader will need at the moment it is true (baseline, counts, flag choices, severity decision from rule 12).
Surgical diffs. No new runtime dependencies. Skill mirrors stay byte-identical if skill text changes (§12.2).

NonGoals.NonGoal: Re-running or re-closing Phases 6–9. Correct close records already amended; do not re-litigate their board rows.
Making the apply gate distinguish self-review from detached review (A33.3 / D11 still require existence of a recorded verdict, not toolkit-verified trustworthiness of residual judgment).
Paying residual graph-module debt, or changing selection / failure-localization behavior.
Full mutate / differential revert-and-rerun as a required audit (Phase 6 Q1 stands).
Auto-remapping active/ ↔ archive/ paths inside the scope audit for historical PR file lists. Close-time audits run while the bundle is still under active/; that is the primary path.
Publishing src/review/scorer.ts or any src/test-support module (invariant 7).

AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PACKED-MODULES-SHIP: A48.5. package.json#files covers the nine production modules under src/gates and src/review that the grace.ts import closure requires. Discriminating negatives: (a) validate:packed is green; (b) removing either directory (or any one of the nine files) from what files covers makes validate:packed red; (c) src/review/scorer.ts is not in the packed tarball (directory entry plus `!src/review/scorer.ts`, or an equivalent file-level list that omits it); (d) release-check dual-allowlist stays consistent with files (same honesty bar as grace-context in Phase 8 and calibration in Phase 9).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-PACKED-IN-CI: A48.5. validate:ci runs validate:packed in the same script chain (not only a separate optional job). Discriminating negative: a deliberate omission of a packed production import fails validate:ci, not only validate:release / prepublishOnly.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SCOPE-DIFF-INPUT: Corr 138. ngrace review accepts a diff input (`--base <ref>` and/or `--changed-files` as planned). Against a branch with committed files outside a named change's ObservedWriteScope, the scope audit reports those paths as review.scope-outside-write-scope. Discriminating negatives: (a) post-commit clean porcelain alone is not treated as "scope clean" when a base ref shows out-of-scope paths; (b) empty porcelain with an active plan and no flags does not enter the audit over `[]` and call that clean; (c) help text names the flags.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SCOPE-ABSENCE-NO-INPUT: Corr 138. When `--change` is set and no changed-files source is available, review emits an explicit absence for the scope audit (reason naming that no changed files were available — clean porcelain / no --base / no --changed-files, or git unavailable), and the summary does not read as a full pass of that audit. Discriminating negative: the exact phrase "No review findings" does not appear as the sole outcome line when the scope audit was skipped for lack of input (patterns may still be clean; the report must still say the scope audit did not run).
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-ARCHIVE-PLAN-RESOLVE: Corr 139. `--change` on an archived bundle resolves plan.xml under archive/ and runs the scope audit when a diff input is also present. Discriminating negative: archived C-SELECTION (or a fixture archive) is not permanently un-auditable solely because it left active/; with `--base` or `--changed-files` showing an out-of-scope path, a finding is emitted.
AcceptanceCriteria.AC-SCOPE-ABSENCE-NO-PLAN: Corr 139. When `--change` names an id with no plan under active/ or archive/, review emits absence (reason: no plan found for <id> under active/ or archive/), never a silent clean scope result. Discriminating negative: "No review findings" alone is false for `--change C-DOES-NOT-EXIST` and for an active id that has only spec.xml.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: validate:packed green (~1.75s class) and listed in validate:ci; npm pack includes the nine modules and excludes scorer.ts; unit tests for --base/--changed-files scope findings, empty porcelain absence, archive plan resolution, and no-plan absence; read-aloud of the four summary states; root lint 0 errors; dual-allowlist green.
